calculation.description: Ranks assets by 20-trading-day return, amplified by directional path efficiency and scaled by the standard deviation of negative daily returns over the trailing 20 days. Uses only information available at the decision date.

validation.regime_notes: Positive IC in all tested regimes; weakest in 2027-2029 (IC 0.003335) and strongest in 2025-2026 (IC 0.101734). Recent 2030-2033 IC was 0.031456 with ICIR 0.132111. Small cross-section implies conservative interpretation of uncertainty.
validation.admission: Passes benchmark absolute 10-day IC >= 0.0070 and absolute 10-day ICIR >= 0.0840.
